description: Gated snare reverb. Big room into a chopping gate on the GateVerb FX, fed from Snare send slot 1. Requires a gate plugin.
name: gate-snare
notes: Precondition: FX track GateVerb with reverb slot 0 and gate slot 1; Snare send slot 1 assigned to it (one-time setup in Cubase).
Multi-track preset: select GateVerb for calls 2-6, then select Snare for calls 7-9. Confirm with session.status before each group.
No gate plugin available: skip this preset.
